items.name: Cutlery
items.description: Knives, forks and spoons. Customers eat with them. They go on the table or in a pot on the counter.

items.name: Crockery
items.description: Plates, bowls, cups and saucers. We serve food and drinks on them.

items.name: Stirrers
items.description: Thin wooden sticks for mixing sugar or milk into a hot drink. They are usually kept by the till for takeaway drinks.

items.name: Napkins
items.description: Small squares of paper or cloth. Customers use them to wipe their hands and mouths. Also called serviettes.

items.name: Saucer
items.description: A small plate that a cup sits on. It catches spills and holds the teaspoon.

items.name: Utensils
items.description: Hand tools for preparing food in the kitchen, such as a knife, a whisk or a peeler.

items.name: Tongs
items.description: A tool with two arms for picking up food without touching it. We use tongs to serve cakes and pastries from the counter.
